# Onboarding guide: psf/requests

## What this project is
The `Requests` library (`psf/requests`) is an open-source HTTP client for Python designed with the philosophy "HTTP for Humans™". It provides an intuitive, user-friendly interface for sending HTTP/1.1 requests while abstracting complex protocol details, and is built on top of `urllib3` for developers interacting with web services and APIs.

## Architecture map
| Area | Path | What lives there |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Core Source Library | [`src/requests`](https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/HEAD/src/requests) | Contains the main source code including `__init__.py`, `__version__.py`, `api.py`, `sessions.py`, `models.py`, and `adapters.py`. |
| Documentation | [`docs`](https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/HEAD/docs) | Sphinx docume
